question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Absense"** is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling is **"Absence"**. (अनुपस्थिति)

 
 
• **Example:** His **absence **from the meeting was noticed by everyone.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abstract** (सार): Existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence.

 
 
• **Example:** The artist's **abstract **concepts were difficult to understand.
 
 
 
• **Abscess** (फोड़ा): A swollen area within body tissue, containing an accumulation of pus.
 
 
• **Example:** He was treated for an **abscess **on his leg.
 
 
 
• **Abstinent** (संयमी): Refraining from an activity or from the consumption of certain substances.
 
 
• **Example:** She remained **abstinent **from alcohol during her pregnancy.
